instruction: You are an HR Generalist sending the annual policy acknowledgement package. Step 1: Open DocuSign and send an envelope titled 'FY2026 Policy Acknowledgement' to 'Ava Thompson' (ava.thompson@northwindcloud.com) with a single signing document 'FY2026 Employee Policy Acknowledgement.pdf' and one signature field labeled 'Employee Signature' placed on the signature line. Step 2: Open Gusto, go to the Documents page, click 'Upload document', and upload a document with category 'Compliance', related employee 'Ava Thompson', and document name 'FY2026 Policy Acknowledgement sent via DocuSign on 2026-07-02; due 2026-07-20.' Step 3: In Slack post to #hr-ops the message: 'Policy ack sent — Ava Thompson (Backend Engineer, start 2026-07-13) received the FY2026 Policy Acknowledgement via DocuSign; due 2026-07-20. Envelope: FY2026 Policy Acknowledgement.'. Do not modify any other employee records or post to other channels.
